items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: He got a little upset and he went and told the owner of the ballroom -- his name was Fogenberg

ctx.x: Everybody said they wouldn't go, wouldn't come to work. He got a little upset and he went and told the owner of the ballroom -- his name was Fogenberg -- so he

said, "Mr. Fogenberg," he says, "you know, I'm running into a little snag. Everybody want to -- the guys in the band want to hear Louie Armstrong tonight." So he says, "Oh, yeah?" He says, "Yeah." So he says, "I don't know what --" he says, "They've told me already. I fined them and they've already paid their fines." He says, "I don't know what to do." So he kind of hesitated for a while, I understand, then he finally told Holder, he says, "Well, I tell you what you do. If you find me a good dance band that can…
